name: Ashfall
description: A constant grey drizzle hides the far walls of every chamber.

name: Leaning Elite
description: Rare elites slip into the rosters of the reavers.

name: Scraps
description: The pit keeps a tithe of every soul you harvest.

name: Bruised Reavers
description: The reavers hit a little harder than they used to.

name: Loose Floor
description: A few floorboards give way and turn a walk into a fight.

name: Mending Ash
description: Ash creeps back into wounds and the fallen rise again.

name: Thick Bones
description: The dead of the pit grow denser and harder to break.

name: Crowned Reavers
description: More of the reavers wear crowns of bone and rime.

name: Sharper Edges
description: Everything in the pit is filed to a killing edge.

name: Harsh Tithe
description: The pit demands a fifth of every soul you pull free.

name: Sinking Floor
description: Whole stretches of the pit collapse into traps.

name: Twin Crowns
description: Elites arrive in pairs and hunt you together.

name: Unbroken
description: The dead of the pit refuse to stay down.

name: Broken Gods
description: Shards of the dead gods fell into the lower halls and cut deep.

name: Stone Skin
description: The stone itself hardens around the reavers.

name: Eternal Dusk
description: The lamps of the pit burn down to a permanent gloom.

name: Grasping Tithe
description: The pit grabs a quarter of everything you earn.

name: Gods' Wrath
description: The curse of the dead gods settles on your shoulders.

name: Shattered Crowns
description: Crowned elites split in two and come apart on you.

name: Fevered Ash
description: The ash burns inside the wounds of the dead.

name: Wall of Bones
description: Bone walls choke the paths and turn every room into a trap.

name: Razor Liturgy
description: The cult of the pit sings sharper prayers.

name: Mountain Bones
description: The dead of the pit wear the weight of the mountain.

name: Gilded Tithe
description: The pit taxes you in gold as well as souls.

name: Hollow Curse
description: The hollow throne breathes on you and takes half of everything.

name: Twin Gods
description: Every elite walks with its twin and they strike as one.

name: Undying Ash
description: Nothing in the pit stays dead for long.

name: Mountain of Teeth
description: The floors are paved with teeth that snap shut underfoot.

name: Final Verdict
description: The dead gods judge every blow and punish every mistake.

name: Bulk of the Dead
description: The corpses of a thousand years pile up and refuse to yield.

name: Glutton's Tithe
description: The pit swallows a third of every soul you earn.
